questions.prompt: A drum belongs to the ___ family.
We make sound by ___ the strings.

Прочитай текст: An orchestra uses different families of instruments. Wind instruments make sound when a player blows into them. Percussion instruments make sound when they are struck. String instruments use strings, and keyboard instruments use keys. The instruments may look different, but instruments in one family share a way of being played.

How are wind instruments played?
